edition.tagline: Two cops. One shower. Zero patience.
edition.cue: Serve the mains when the armoured RV rolls out.

s.note: Crisp butter griddled white bread with devon, cheese and mustard.
s.how: Spread 8 slices white bread with 20g yellow mustard. Layer 120g devon and 80g American-style cheese between the slices to make four sandwiches. Butter the outside using 30g softened butter. Griddle over medium heat under a weighted pan for 3 minutes each side until crisp and the cheese melts. Cut each into fingers to share.

s.note: Chopped grilled steak tacos with onion, coriander and salsa verde.
s.how: Marinate 500g skirt steak in the juice of 2 limes, 2 garlic cloves and 1 tsp cumin for 1 hour. Grill hot for 3 minutes a side, rest and chop small. Warm 12 small corn tortillas and fill with the steak, diced white onion, coriander and salsa verde, lime wedges on the side.

m.note: Dry brined steak basted with butter, thyme and garlic.
m.how: Pat dry four 200g rib eye steaks, season with 1 tsp fine salt and refrigerate uncovered for 4 to 12 hours to dry-brine. Heat a heavy pan with 1 tbsp neutral oil until hot. Sear the steaks hard for about 3 minutes per side in batches. Lower the heat and add 50g butter, 4 thyme sprigs and 3 crushed garlic cloves. Baste for 1 to 2 minutes. Remove at 54°C in the centre for medium rare, or cook longer if preferred. Rest for 8 minutes, slice and spoon over the pan butter.

w.note: Vanilla cupcakes with pink buttercream and a generous coat of sprinkles.
w.how: Beat 80g softened butter with 80g caster sugar until pale. Beat in 1 egg and 1 tsp vanilla extract. Fold in 100g self-raising flour and 40ml milk. Divide between 8 cupcake cases and bake at 180°C conventional for 18 minutes until a skewer comes out clean. Cool completely. Beat 60g softened butter with 120g icing sugar and 1 tsp milk until fluffy; tint with a little pink food colouring. Pipe onto the cupcakes and cover with 20g sprinkles. Serve two small cupcakes each.

d.note: Cold lager served straight from the bottle for a celebratory clink.
d.how: Chill four 375ml bottles of lager in the fridge for at least 2 hours. Open just before serving and clink the bottles carefully to celebrate the breakout.
